name: gizza-ai/video-ken-burns
summary: Animate a still image with a smooth pan-and-zoom (Ken Burns) effect into a short video clip.

tool.description: Animate a still image into a short MP4 clip with a smooth pan-and-zoom (Ken Burns) move. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call). Optional direction (zoom-in [default], zoom-out, pan-left, pan-right, pan-up, pan-down), duration (seconds 1-30, default 5), zoom (peak factor 1.0-2.0, default 1.3), width/height in pixels (default 1280x720), and fps (default 30). Output is an H.264 MP4.

direction.description: Ken Burns move (default zoom-in): zoom-in, zoom-out, or pan-left/right/up/down.

height.description: Output height in pixels, 16-3840 (default 720; snapped to an even number).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Output width in pixels, 16-3840 (default 1280; snapped to an even number).

zoom.description: Peak zoom factor, 1.0-2.0 (default 1.3). Panning needs > 1 to have room to move.
